scoring_justification: The analytic formulas from the paper allow exact recomputation of expected wave functions and average energy from the given parameters; thus T1 recompute is feasible.

properties.psi1: array of [float, float] pairs (real and imaginary parts)
properties.psi2: array of [float, float] pairs (real and imaginary parts)

outputs.description: Contains the computed excitation wave functions and average interaction energy for all test cases. The checker will recompute expected values from the analytic formulas and compare.

output_contract.notes: The checker will recompute the expected average energy and wave functions using the analytic expressions derived in the paper (average_energy = 2*V*alpha*beta, wave functions via exponential combinations of alpha, beta, V, and t). Comparisons will use appropriate floating-point tolerances.

steps.description: Recompute expected psi1, psi2, and average energy from the analytic formulas and compare to submitted values within tolerances. All four test cases must pass.
